name: xr3_sheercold_sub
purpose: Sheer Cold (OHKO, decision 0015 item 5ca) into a Substitute: the sub takes the hit, so the hit is the sub's (the target has full HP and no faint). Gengar (M) raises its sub on turn 1; Glalie (M)'s Sheer Cold, an accuracy-30 OHKO, hits it on the first turn that it lands, which prints the bare -ohko before the -end of the sub (data/moves.ts:18357, 18368-18374); turn 2 Gengar's Shadow Ball and Primarina's Moonblast show the target is open again. Gengar and Glalie are male; Primarina and Milotic female.
